system.passive: Will cooperate with anything the crew asks. Has a three-second memory.
system.notes:
Note: persuading it is Difficulty 1. It will agree. It will forget. It cannot actually help with anything.

Speed: 3 (within its bowl).
system.biography:
“Will Cooperate. Cannot Help.”

The most agreeable creature in any location. It will cooperate with whatever the crew asks, forget the entire arrangement within three seconds, and be of no practical use to the plan whatsoever.
